harness.capacity_claim: Bounded transactional probes; no maximum HTTP/user capacity established.

limitations: No live HTTP server, network or production cache benchmark
No saturation, sustained load or universal user-capacity measurement
No application-database writes or server/role setting changes
MIME verification mocked for state-import scenario
SQLite skips real PostgreSQL locking scenarios

user_capacity_interpretation.measured_scenario: learning completions for distinct users against one shared question
user_capacity_interpretation.model: active users = workers * assumed utilization / assumed worker seconds per request * assumed seconds between requests per user
user_capacity_interpretation.status: Conditional illustration; request times and cadences are assumptions, not measured deployed capacity.
user_capacity_interpretation.scope: Steady spread-out traffic; include all API/background requests; extra contention and expensive work can reduce capacity.
